meta.title: Extend twice
gaps: Verify that the prepared live RFQ has no bids.
Assert that Order Activity contains both extension records specifically.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the prepared live RFQ has no bids.; Assert that Order Activity contains both extension records specifically.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event without searching the events list.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the case.
Extend the current submission deadline by 10 minutes and verify the saved end-time change.
Extend the already extended deadline by another 10 minutes and verify the second saved change.
Open the RFQ stage's Activity drawer to inspect the extension history.
Assert that the Order Activity drawer opened; the catalog cannot reliably assert both extension entries.
